title: Minimum Operations to Make Array Alternating
statement: You are given an array of integers `nums` of length `n`. In one operation, you can choose any index `i` (0-indexed) and change `nums[i]` to any integer value. Your task is to find the minimum number of operations required to make the array alternating. An array is alternating if for every index `i` (0 <= i < n-1), `nums[i] != nums[i+1]`.
summary: Find the minimum number of value changes needed to make adjacent elements in an array unequal.

examples.explanation: One way to make the array alternating is to change nums[1] to 2, nums[3] to 1, and nums[5] to 1, resulting in [3,2,3,1,4,1].
Change nums[2] to 1 and nums[4] to 1 to get [1,2,1,2,1].
Change nums[1] to 2 and nums[3] to 2 to get [1,2,1,2,1].
